source.note: Search summary (results: Deer Valley media room 29 Jun 2026 "Expanded Excellence" update, deervalley.com Explore the Mountain, Coleman Concierge, Park Record): for 2026-27 about 4,500 skiable acres and 209 runs; 32 aerial lifts (2 gondolas, 23 detachable and 7 fixed-grip chairlifts). Surface lifts and carpets are not stated, so "lifts" counts aerial lifts only. The new Hail Peak Express (86 chairs, up to 2,400 skiers/hour; placed by helicopter in Sep 2026) adds about 200 acres and 7 runs for 2026-27. Ability split not captured. TownLift (Sep 17, 2026, CI-fetched): Hail Peak Express "brings Deer Valley to 209 runs and approximately 4,500 skiable acres ... Deer Valley will operate 32 chairlifts this winter"; up to 932 acres of snowmaking.

Day operations only (reference). Slopeside lodging at Snow Park, Silver Lake and Empire Pass. Skiers only — snowboards are not allowed

character: A skiers-only resort (no snowboards) beside Park City, separately ticketed from Park City Mountain, known for extensive grooming and a service-focused approach. Its original terrain spreads from the Snow Park base up through Silver Lake to Empire Canyon, and it is in the middle of a multi-year expansion toward a new East Village base near Jordanelle Reservoir.
learning: Reference note: beginner terrain is at the Snow Park base (the Wide West learning area) with more green runs around Silver Lake, and the resort runs its own ski school. Skiing only. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson products.

source.note: Official homepage (read 2026-10-03): "DEER VALLEY OPENING DAY SATURDAY, DECEMBER 5, 2026". TownLift (Sep 17, 2026): resort "targeting Dec. 5 for the start of its 2026-27 ski season"; could open earlier or later depending on conditions.

Search summary: 2025-26 opening Dec. 6, 2025 (Ski Utah 2025-26 opening-dates list) and an early closure on Mar. 29, 2026 because of unseasonably warm conditions (Deseret News, 26 Mar 2026: https://www.deseret.com/lifestyle/2026/03/26/utah-ski-season-snow-forecast-deer-valley-closing/).

season.notes: 2026-27: Opening Day Saturday, Dec. 5, 2026 (official homepage); phased opening around Snow Park and Silver Lake first (TownLift, Sep 17, 2026). No closing date announced.

prices.note: 2026-27 peak-day adult ticket $349 — the ceiling of Deer Valley's dynamic pricing ("better understood as the ceiling for a peak ski day"); advance and non-peak dates are cheaper but not captured. 2025-26 peak walk-up was $329.

source.note: TownLift (Sep 4, 2026, read 2026-10-03): "For the 2026-27 season, a peak-day adult lift ticket at Park City Mountain will cost $369 ... Deer Valley will charge $349."

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-80 E through Parleys Canyon to Exit 145 / Kimball Junction, then SR-224 into Park City); not a routing-service result. Winter storms on I-80 add time. Snow Park is a few minutes past downtown Park City.
